issues.detail: The Greek 'φρονειν εις το σωφρονειν' implies 'to exercise self-control' or 'to behave soberly/sensibly.' The Vietnamese translation 'có tâm tình tầm thường' (having an ordinary/mediocre disposition) captures a sense of humility but misses the specific nuance of 'σωφρονειν', which refers to self-restraint and sound judgment.
